verdict.rationale: Summer Engine documents agent-driven automation through its own MCP server and CLI: any agent gets the same tools and can build, test and publish a game, which is a form of programmatic engine automation. Nothing documents extending the editor itself, such as custom editor tools, editor scripts or a plugin API, and native C++/C# is framed as game code rather than editor extension. Missing for 10: documented editor scripting or plugin API, custom tool/panel creation, explicit programmatic scene and asset manipulation APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can extend and automate the editor itself — custom tools, editor scripts, plugins that manipulate scenes and assets programmatically

citations.quote: Bring Claude Code, Codex, Hermes or whatever agent you prefer, and it gets the same tools.
Any agent builds, tests and publishes a full multiplayer game
Your agent runs the whole publishing flow on Summer Games through the MCP or CLI.
